children: USD.AI has a CHIP supply unlock scheduled for May 2027. The release will distribute at least 147.12 million CHIP to investors and team members. That amount is equivalent to 7.36% of the circulating supply.
The release is part of CHIP's monthly vesting schedule. Once the tokens are unlocked, investors and team members can sell CHIP that was previously locked under that schedule.
